title: 🎓 教程：东北太平洋（FAO 67区）从零到报告
text: 🔎 怎么看这张图：七个指标，每个指标一个分面：上报渔获量的物种条目数和国家数、物种的香农多样性指数、物种和国家的赫芬达尔-赫希曼指数（HHI），以及最大的五个物种和五个国家所占的份额。HHI从接近0（渔获量分散在许多物种或国家上）到10000（全部来自一个）；高于2500为“高度集中”。 67区的结果：2024年，有95个物种条目和5个国家上报了渔获量。两个指数都高于2500：国家的HHI为9135，接近最大值，因为几乎全部渔获都由美国捕捞；物种的HHI为3295，原因是狭鳕。该渔区物种很多，但渔获量依赖于一个国家和一个物种。
code: div <- diversity_concentration(area67)

previous_headings: 8. 🔍 数据质量、多样性与船队
title: 🎓 教程：东北太平洋（FAO 67区）从零到报告
text: 🔎 怎么看这些图：country_income：按世界银行收入分组统计的各国渔获量。coastal_distant：根据FAO渔区边界和国家轮廓，分为沿岸国（领土与该渔区接壤）和远洋捕捞国的渔获量。 67区的结果：几乎全部渔获量都由高收入国家捕捞；1960和1970年代“未分类”的部分是已不复存在的苏联。远洋捕捞国（日本、大韩民国、波兰等）1960年占渔获量的26%，1981年最高达到59%；1994年降到1%以下，此后一直如此。注意苏联和俄罗斯联邦算作沿岸国，因为俄罗斯在白令海的部分海岸与该渔区接壤：1990年以前外国船队所占的份额比远洋捕捞国的份额还要大。
code: income <- country_group_summary(area67) fleets <- coastal_distant(area67)

title: 🎓 教程：东北太平洋（FAO 67区）从零到报告
text: 这些分析采用已发表的方法；🔬 渔获骤变、渔业崩溃、同步性与远洋捕捞详细介绍了每一种方法。

title: 🎓 教程：东北太平洋（FAO 67区）从零到报告
text: 🔎 怎么看这些图：骤变是指某条序列的渔获量远低于其前几年所预示水平的年份（Cottrell等，2019）。柱状图给出每年发生骤变的序列所占的百分比；_series图显示各条序列及其骤变，_by_country和_by_continent图按分组统计骤变。 67区的结果：按国家划分序列（= c("country", "area")，默认设置）时，67区只有8条序列，因此每次骤变都占很大的百分比，图很粗糙。按物种划分则有98条序列和35次骤变，对单个渔区来说信息更丰富。按问题选择序列：研究国家的食物供给用国家序列，研究生态用物种序列。
code: shocks_country <- catch_shocks(area67) shocks_species <- catch_shocks(area67, by = "species", label = "area67_species")

title: 🎓 教程：东北太平洋（FAO 67区）从零到报告
text: 🔎 怎么看这张图：一条序列（一个国家捕捞的一个物种）在达到最高值之后，如果渔获量连续四年低于最高值的十分之一，即为崩溃（Mullon等，2005）。柱状图按年份以及崩溃前下降的形态（平台型、平滑型或波动型）统计崩溃次数。函数还会在没有趋势的随机序列上重复同样的分析，因为单是随机的涨落就会产生一些“崩溃”（Wilberg和Miller，2007）：只有超出这一零模型的部分才有意义。 67区的结果：50条序列中有10条崩溃（20%），而随机序列中为21%。这与单靠随机波动产生的比例相当，所以从整体上看，67区的崩溃并不能证明存在全渔区性的问题；应当逐条查看具体的序列。这正是零模型的意义所在：没有它，“20%的序列崩溃了”听起来会令人担忧。
code: set.seed(1)   # 与随机序列的比较要用到随机数 collapses <- collapse_analysis(area67) show_table(collapses$summary)

title: 🎓 教程：东北太平洋（FAO 67区）从零到报告
text: 🔎 怎么看这些图：_cv：每个物种以及总渔获量（红色）的变异系数（年际波动）。_correlation：各物种之间如何共同变化。同步性指数φ在各物种相互补偿时为0，在同涨同落时为1（Loreau和de Mazancourt，2008）。 67区的结果：φ = 0.30：总渔获量的波动（变异系数0.21）远小于各物种的波动（平均变异系数0.54）：各物种的变异平均比它们的总和大161%。这种组合效应意味着一个物种减少时，其他物种会补上它的位置。在图中的主要物种里，Pacific ocean perch的波动远大于其他物种，这是它暴涨暴跌的痕迹。
code: sync <- catch_synchrony(area67)

title: 🎓 教程：东北太平洋（FAO 67区）从零到报告
text: 🔎 怎么看这些图：P/D是小型中上层鱼的渔获量除以底层鱼和甲壳类的渔获量（Caddy，1993；de Leiva Moreno等，2000），用对数坐标表示；虚线为P/D = 1。在半封闭海域，P/D上升与营养盐增加有关；在开阔海域，它主要反映船队的捕捞对象。 67区的结果：P/D从1950年代的0.95降到2020年代的0.016。这并不说明海里的营养盐减少了：鲱鱼渔业萎缩，而底层鱼的拖网渔业扩大，所以这个比值讲述的是渔业的历史。
code: pd <- pelagic_demersal(area67) show_table(pd$decades[, c("period", "pd_mean", "pd_min", "pd_max")])

title: 🎓 教程：东北太平洋（FAO 67区）从零到报告
text: 🔎 怎么看这些图：一个国家在与其相邻的FAO渔区（“邻近渔区”）和其他渔区（“远洋渔区”）的渔获量、远洋渔获所占的比例、每年作业的渔区数，以及它进入每个渔区的时间（Swartz等，2010）。 结果：日本唯一的邻近渔区是61区。它的远洋渔获比例在1970年升到最高的23.1%，当年在13个远洋FAO渔区作业；那一年仅67区就提供了139.1万t，占其远洋渔获的70%。1970年代末的200海里专属区关闭了其中最富饶的水域，2024年这一比例为7.6%。67区和日本展示了同一变化的两个方面。
code: japan_dw <- distant_water_profile("Japan")

title: 🎓 教程：东北太平洋（FAO 67区）从零到报告
text: 🔎 怎么看这张表：每个FAO物种条目按已发表的规则与FishBase或SeaLifeBase匹配（学名完全相同、同物异名、WoRMS、更高分类阶元的平均值）；match_type说明用的是哪条规则，每一行都附有核对用的链接。version = "builtin"使用本包内置的表格，因此不联网也能运行。匹配结果只是初步结果：请用链接核对主要物种（见🐠 FishBase与SeaLifeBase物种特征）。
code: traits <- fishbase_match(area67, version = "builtin") show_table(traits[, c("species_en", "catch_pct", "match_type", "trophic_level", "temp_pref_mean")], n = 8)

id: 海表温度与渔获平均温度
what: 10.2 海表温度与渔获平均温度
title: 🎓 教程：东北太平洋（FAO 67区）从零到报告
text: 🔎 怎么看这张图：渔获平均温度（MTC，红线）是渔获物种偏好温度的平均值，按渔获量加权（Cheung等，2013）；蓝线是该渔区的海表温度（SST），浅色带是它在渔区内的范围。下半部分是偏好温度已知的渔获量所占的比例；低于50%的年份淡化显示。MTC上升，说明暖水物种在渔获中所占的比例变大。 67区的结果：MTC保持在2.7至3.8 °C之间，远低于该渔区的SST（2024年为9.9 °C）。原因在于物种：主要渔获是生活在近底层的冷水性鱼类，如狭鳕（偏好温度1.6 °C）和太平洋鳕（2.9 °C）。MTC在1972年最低，当年狭鳕占渔获量的52%；在1967年最高，那时狭鳕渔业尚未壮大；美国西海岸的北太平洋无须鳕（8.6 °C）渔获量大的年份会把它拉高。MTC在1950–2024年间的趋势为“无趋势”（每十年0.009 °C），在1970–2024年间为“无趋势”（每十年0.056 °C），同期SST每十年升高0.21 °C。67区的MTC主要反映目标物种的组成，而不是海洋：要结合物种图来看。
code: sst67 <- fao_area_sst("Pacific, Northeast") mtc <- mean_temperature_catch(area67, version = "builtin") show_table(mtc$trend[, c("period_start", "period_end", "mtc_slope_per_decade", "trend", "sst_slope_per_decade", "cor_mtc_sst")])

title: 🎓 教程：东北太平洋（FAO 67区）从零到报告
text: cmsy_area()对渔获量最大的几个物种运行CMSY++仅渔获量资源评估（Froese等，2023）。它需要先安装一次JAGS程序（cmsy_setup()，见📉 CMSY++仅渔获量资源评估），运行需要几分钟；下面的图是事先用同样的代码生成的。 🔎 怎么看Kobe图：每个圆圈是一个种群在最后一年的状态：横轴是生物量与产生最大可持续产量的生物量之比（B/Bmsy），纵轴是捕捞压力与产生最大可持续产量的捕捞压力之比（F/Fmsy）；圆圈的大小表示渔获量。绿色（右下）：健康；红色（左上）：已过度捕捞且仍在过度捕捞；橙色和黄色：两者之一。B/Bmsy = 0.8处的虚线，按照FAO对仅渔获量结果的分级，把“最大可持续捕捞”与“过度捕捞”分开。 67区的结果：在评估的10个种群中，有6个在最后一年低于0.8 Bmsy；最低的是太平洋鲱（0.26）和Pacific ocean perch（0.37），也就是渔获量离其峰值最远的两个渔业。 🔎 怎么看这张图：每个种群一行：最后一年的B/Bmsy及其95%置信限（横条），颜色表示状态。横条越长，说明数据越难确定该种群的资源量。 🔎 怎么看这张图：逐年各状态类别的种群所占比例，可以看出该渔区的种群是否同步变化，例如是否在同一时期一起下降。 🔎 怎么看这张图：渔获量最大的种群（狭鳕）的“管理图”：左上为渔获量和MSY，右上为相对捕捞死亡率F/Fmsy，左下为相对资源量B/Bmsy及Bmsy和0.8 Bmsy两条线，右下为该种群在Kobe图中的变化路径；阴影为95%置信限。全部CMSY++图表见📉 CMSY++资源评估。 FAO捕捞统计没有丰度指数，所以这些都是仅渔获量评估，结果在很大程度上由先验决定：只具有指示意义，绝不能替代完整的资源评估。这一点在67区尤其重要：它的大多数主要种群每年都由美国和加拿大的渔业管理机构利用调查数据进行评估，渔获量受捕捞限额控制，因此一个停留在过去峰值以下的渔获量，可能被仅渔获量方法解读为资源量减少。使用这些结果之前，请与官方评估进行比较。CMSY++的代码来自其作者（https://github.com/SISTA16/cmsyPlusPlus）；见📉 CMSY++仅渔获量资源评估中的免责说明。
code: cmsy_setup()                                            # 只需一次：安装JAGS和所需的R包 nep_cmsy <- cmsy_area("Pacific, Northeast", top = 10)   # 十个主要物种 nep_cmsy$summary                                        # B/Bmsy、F/Fmsy、MSY和资源状态

title: 🎓 教程：东北太平洋（FAO 67区）从零到报告
text: fao_report()运行该渔区的各项分析，把整个评估写成一份报告：封面、摘要、数据与方法、附图表的结果、结论、参考文献和附录。这里生成一份中文Word报告，在默认章节之外加入渔获骤变和渔获平均温度： Word文件的各级标题：
code: report <- fao_report(67, lang = "zh", shocks = TRUE, mtc = TRUE) report #> FAO report: /tmp/RtmpVTs0Gn/faofishingreport_site_21a373bafb089/reports/FAO67_report_zh.docx #> Sections: total, species, countries, groups, status, quality, diversity, fleets, shocks, mtc #>   $main_species           main species of the last five years (10 rows) #>   $main_countries         main fishing countries of the last five years (5 rows) #>   $mtc_species            species of the mean temperature of the catch, with FishBase matches (200 rows) #>   $analyses               results of the analyses: total, species, countries, groups, status, quality, diversity, fleets, shocks, mtc doc <- officer::docx_summary(officer::read_docx(report$file[["docx"]])) headings <- doc$text[doc$style_name %in% c("FAO Heading 1", "FAO Heading 2")] headings #>  [1] "1 数据来源与分析方法"     "1.1 数据来源"             #>  [3] "1.2 分析方法"             "2 结果与结论"             #>  [5] "2.1 渔获量变化与阶段划分" "2.2 主要渔获种类"         #>  [7] "2.3 主要捕捞国家（地区）" "2.4 渔获类群组成"         #>  [9] "2.5 资源开发状态"         "2.6 数据质量"             #> [11] "2.7 渔获多样性与集中度"   "2.8 沿岸国与远洋捕捞"     #> [13] "2.9 渔获骤变"             "2.10 渔获平均温度"        #> [15] "2.11 结论"                "参考文献"                 #> [17] "附件"

title: 🎓 教程：东北太平洋（FAO 67区）从零到报告
text: Word文件和LaTeX源文件（format = "latex"）不需要其他软件。PDF由LaTeX源文件用XeLaTeX编译而成，XeLaTeX包含在LaTeX发行版中。最简单的是TinyTeX（Xie，2019），一个在R中就能安装的小型发行版，不需要管理员权限： 第一次生成PDF会慢一些：TinyTeX会下载报告用到的LaTeX宏包（中文报告需要ctex和中文字体等），并保存下来供以后使用。如果TinyTeX是很早以前安装的，生成PDF时出现“TeX Live older remote”之类的信息，用tinytex::reinstall_tinytex()更新。其他情况（使用其他LaTeX发行版、编译修改过的.tex文件）见📝 一键生成评估报告。
code: install.packages("tinytex") tinytex::install_tinytex()   # 只需一次，几分钟；装完后重启R tinytex::is_tinytex()        # 安装成功时返回TRUE

title: 🎓 教程：东北太平洋（FAO 67区）从零到报告
text: 同一份中文报告的LaTeX和PDF版本，并加入CMSY++（沿用第11步的结果，不必再次运行CMSY++）： 报告是一份初稿：文字由模板填入分析结果生成。请通读全文，补充灰色的“【待补充：……】”备注（其他数据来源、讨论、其他参考文献），并对照上面的图表核对每一条结论。全部选项见📝 一键生成评估报告（Word、LaTeX、PDF）。
code: fao_report(67, lang = "zh", format = c("docx", "latex", "pdf"), shocks = TRUE, mtc = TRUE,            cmsy = nep_cmsy)

what: 13. 🗂️ 文件保存在哪里，如何重新读取

title: faofishingreport: FAO capture statistics, charts and reports
text: 💾 Always latest data: check download new FAO releases one command, compare releases see FAO revised. 🌊 Fishing area analyses: total catch breakpoints, share world marine catch, main species, main countries, maps. 🐟 Species country profiles: catches species, country catches, fishes far distant-water fleet goes. 📊 Summary analyses: species groups, stock status plots, peak trend, data quality, diversity concentration, country groups, synchronous breakpoints, coastal distant-water fleets, pelagic demersal ratio, FAO marine areas compared. 🔬 Analyses literature: catch shocks (Cottrell et al. 2019; Gephart et al. 2017), fishery collapses (Mullon et al. 2005; Worm et al. 2006) random null model, synchrony portfolio effect (Loreau & de Mazancourt 2008). 🌡️ FishBase sea temperature: FishBase SeaLifeBase traits matched FAO species (data snapshots rfishbase project), sea surface temperature FAO areas, mean temperature catch (Cheung et al. 2013). 📉 CMSY++ stock assessment main species (Froese et al. 2023; code authors https://github.com/SISTA16/cmsyPlusPlus, bundled unchanged), JAGS set computer, charts, projections tables reference points priors. 📝 Assessment report one call: fao_report() writes report Chinese English, Word, LaTeX PDF (cover, abstract, data methods, results, conclusions, references, appendix), every analysis switched settings function given prefix. 🌐 English, Chinese bilingual charts official FAO Chinese names. 🎨 style: themes, colour palettes, map projections (Robinson, Mollweide, Equal Earth, …) Pacific-centred maps, set fao_settings(). 💻 Windows, macOS Linux: Chinese font chosen automatically; tables open Excel Chinese names intact.

code: library(faofishingreport)  # Get the latest FAO release (only needed when FAO publishes a new one) check_fao_update() download_fao_data()  # All FAO major fishing areas, and area 27 (Northeast Atlantic) with its subareas fao_areas() fishing_area_map(27)  # FAO major fishing area 27, Northeast Atlantic FAO27 <- fishing_area_data("Atlantic, Northeast") fishing_area_species(FAO27$area_data, rank_range = c(1, 10)) fishing_area_country(FAO27$area_data, rank_range = c(1, 10))  # Who catches Atlantic cod, what Norway catches species_country(FAO27$area_data, "Atlantic cod", lang = "both") country_species(FAO27$area_data, "Norway")  # Summary analyses and analyses from the literature stock_status(FAO27$area_data) catch_shocks(FAO27$area_data) mean_temperature_catch(FAO27$area_data, version = "builtin")  # CMSY++ for the ten main species (run cmsy_setup() once before) cmsy_area("Atlantic, Northeast", top = 10)  # An assessment report of the area, in Chinese, with CMSY++ and catch shocks, # as Word and PDF (LaTeX) report <- fao_report(27, lang = "zh", cmsy = TRUE, shocks = TRUE, format = c("docx", "pdf"))

title: Catch Shocks — catch_shocks
text: series (e.g. catch one country one FAO area) smoothed, residuals smooth regressed residuals year (lag-1 regression). Years whose Cook's distance regression exceeds threshold candidate shocks; catch fell level preceding years kept: "cottrell2019" (default) LOESS span 0.6, Cook's distance 0.3; loss measured median catch previous 7 years, first 7 years series shocks (Cottrell et al. 2019, Methods, code https://github.com/cottrellr/shocks). "gephart2017" lowess span 2/3, Cook's distance 0.35; loss measured mean catch previous 5 years (Gephart et al. 2017, section 2, code https://github.com/jagephart/Shock_Detection). shock recovered first later year catch back least 95% baseline. yearly shock frequency number shocks year divided number series analysed year (Cottrell et al. 2019): series counts first year catch last year, including years catch fell zero; shock rate area, country species group number shocks divided number series (Gephart et al. 2017). studies analysed national totals (species areas country); = "country" data areas (load_fao_data()) series . Neither study states minimum series length; min_years choice package, ending series countries longer exist (e.g. USSR) last year catch, end country counted shock. Highly variable series (e.g. Peruvian anchoveta) may show shocks large changes usual (Gephart et al. 2017).

title: Synchrony and Stability of the Catch — catch_synchrony
text: Series chosen Ong et al. (2021): median catch min_median (10) tonnes year min_nonzero (3/4) years catch; = "species", items identified species used (Ong et al. left miscellaneous "nei" items). series detrended linear regression year (Ong et al.), since trends make series look synchronous (Lepš et al. 2019); use detrend = "none" keep . standard deviations \(\sigma_i\) series, standard deviation \(\sigma_T\) total catch mean \(m_T\): synchrony \(\phi = \sigma_T^2 / (\sum_i \sigma_i)^2\), 0 (fluctuations fully compensate ) 1 (perfectly synchronous) (Loreau de Mazancourt 2008, eq. 9); coefficient variation (CV) total catch equals \(\sqrt{\phi}\) times weighted mean CV series, \(\sum_i \sigma_i / m_T\) (Thibaut Connolly 2013, eqs. 2-4): lower synchrony, stable total; portfolio effect = (mean CV series - CV total) / CV total x 100 (Ong et al. 2021, Carlson Satterthwaite 2011): much variable single series total, percent. measures computed moving windows window years (linear trend removed window, choice package) show synchrony changed time. Ong et al. (2021) measured synchrony wavelet coherence, separates time scales; function uses simpler correlation-based measures .

title: Sea Surface Temperature of the FAO Major Fishing Areas — fao_area_sst
text: Built (default): NOAA ERSST v5 package comes yearly SST 19 areas 1950, computed NOAA Extended Reconstructed SST version 5 (Huang et al. 2017): monthly reconstruction 2° x 2° grid (220 km) situ observations (ships buoys ICOADS, Argo floats 1999). smallest common SST products, needs download, consistent whole period; grid coarse small areas Mediterranean Black Sea (n_cells gives number grid cells area). NetCDF files Give path NetCDF file, folder NetCDF files, sst, session fao_settings(sst = "path"). files must hold gridded SST longitude, latitude time, monthly daily (e.g. HadISST, COBE-SST2, OISST, ERSST, model output). yearly area means computed first time, can take minutes, saved sst folder data_dir; later calls files read saved table. Reading NetCDF files needs ncdf4 package. Downloaded download_sst_data() download_sst_data() downloads one products listed fao_sst_products() (HadISST1, COBE-SST2, OISST v2.1, newest years ERSST v5) computes table; used name, e.g. sst = "hadisst1".

what: How the area means are computed
title: Sea Surface Temperature of the FAO Major Fishing Areas — fao_area_sst
text: Files: SST variable found name ("sst", "analysed_sst", "tos", ...) unless given variable; longitudes may run -180 180 0 360; values kelvin converted °C; several depths, first (surface) used. Values -5 °C, products use mark sea ice (-1000 HadISST1), set -1.8 °C, value products give sea ice. Daily values averaged month. Grids finer 1° first averaged 1° (mean cells value). grid cell counts FAO major area overlaps (inst/extdata/FAO_AREAS_CWP.shp, 19 marine areas), weighted area overlap computed sphere, cells boundary shared coastal cells count sea part . sst_mean mean 12 monthly area means; sst_p10 sst_p90 weighted 10th 90th percentiles yearly mean SST cells (range within area); sst_min_month sst_max_month coldest warmest monthly area means (seasonal range; areas sides equator seasons two hemispheres partly cancel, range narrow ). years 12 months kept. Values Arctic Sea Antarctic areas partly reflect sea ice rather measured water temperature. SST products use different observations methods, values trends differ somewhat; repeating analysis second product shows much result depends product.

code: fao_report(   area,   ...,   file = NULL,   format = "docx",   lang = NULL,   title = NULL,   report_no = 1,   author = NULL,   affiliation = NULL,   project = NULL,   date = Sys.Date(),   font = NULL,   font_zh = "FangSong",   citation = c("apa", "fao"),   top_n = 10,   data_version = "latest",   total = TRUE,   species = TRUE,   countries = TRUE,   groups = TRUE,   status = TRUE,   quality = TRUE,   diversity = TRUE,   fleets = TRUE,   shocks = FALSE,   collapse = FALSE,   synchrony = FALSE,   pelagic = FALSE,   mtc = FALSE,   distant = FALSE,   cmsy = FALSE )

title: Assessment Report of an FAO Fishing Area — fao_report
text: area FAO major fishing area: name, e.g. "Atlantic, Eastern Central", code, e.g. 34. ... Settings analyses, named section prefix: total_ fishing_area_data(), species_ fishing_area_species(), countries_ fishing_area_country(), groups_ species_group_composition(), status_ stock_status(), quality_ data_quality(), diversity_ diversity_concentration(), fleets_ coastal_distant(), shocks_ catch_shocks(), collapse_ collapse_analysis() (collapse_seed, seed random series, default 1), synchrony_ catch_synchrony(), pelagic_ pelagic_demersal(), mtc_ mean_temperature_catch() (report uses mtc_version = "builtin", FishBase data bundled package, unless another version given), distant_ distant_water_profile() (distant_countries, number distant-water countries profiled, default 3, names) cmsy_ cmsy_area() (cmsy_input()). example species_h_value = 0.2, countries_line_linewidth = 1, status_smooth = TRUE, cmsy_top = 5 cmsy_settings = list(n.iter = 100000). name argument function gives error listing arguments. arguments report sets (area_data, area_name, area, lang, table pptx) changed, can pelagic_by mtc_by (analyses division use data load_fao_divisions(), extension part report). file file write. Default reports/FAO<code>_report_<lang>.docx working directory. formats get name .tex .pdf. format formats write, one "docx" (default: Word), "latex" (.tex file figures folder <name>_figures/ next , compiled XeLaTeX; Chinese reports use ctexart class) "pdf" (LaTeX file compiled PDF XeLaTeX, tinytex package installed, also installs missing LaTeX packages). Install TinyTeX install.packages("tinytex") tinytex::install_tinytex(); old TinyTeX updated tinytex::reinstall_tinytex(). analyses run formats, formats text, figures, tables references. Fonts taken computer: Chinese, FangSong, SimHei KaiTi Windows, STFangsong, Heiti SC Kaiti SC macOS, else Fandol fonts TeX Live. lang language report: "zh" (Chinese) "en" (English). Default NULL, language set fao_settings() ("" gives Chinese report). title report title. Default generated area, e.g. "Assessment Marine Capture Production FAO Major Fishing Area 34 (Atlantic, Eastern Central)". report_no number report, shown "Report 1" (Chinese reports Chinese numeral) used figure table numbers (1-1, 1-2, ...). Default 1. author author cover title. Default NULL, writes "Author" ("作者" Chinese reports) placeholder. affiliation affiliation cover. Default NULL, none. project text top cover. Default NULL, writes "Project Report" ("课题报告" Chinese reports). date date cover. Default today. font font text Latin script. Default "Times New Roman" Chinese reports "Arial" English reports. font_zh font Chinese body text. Default "FangSong". citation citation style English reports: "apa" (default) "fao" (style FAO publications). Chinese reports use numbered citations (GB/T 7714). top_n number main species countries charts tables, species assessed CMSY++ (unless cmsy_top given). Default 10. data_version FAO release use, load_fao_data(). Default "latest". total, species, countries, groups, status, quality, diversity, fleets Logical values: whether report section total catch stages (fishing_area_data()), main species (fishing_area_species()), main fishing countries (fishing_area_country()), ISSCAAP groups (species_group_composition()), stock status plots (stock_status()), data quality (data_quality()), diversity concentration catch (diversity_concentration()) coastal distant-water fleets (coastal_distant()). TRUE default. shocks, collapse, synchrony, pelagic, mtc, distant Logical values: whether report sections catch shocks (catch_shocks()), fishery collapses (collapse_analysis()), synchrony catch portfolio effect (catch_synchrony()), pelagic demersal ratio (pelagic_demersal()), mean temperature catch (mean_temperature_catch()) profiles main distant-water fleets area (distant_water_profile()). FALSE default. cmsy logical value. TRUE, main species also assessed CMSY++ (cmsy_area()), report part assessment, results every species appendix tables reference points, priors sources. Default FALSE. result earlier cmsy_area() run can also given, write report without running CMSY++ ; must area FAO release report (data_version), else report stops. CMSY++ needs JAGS: see cmsy_setup().

title: Assessment Report of an FAO Fishing Area — fao_report
text: Invisibly, list class fao_report paths files written (file, named format: docx, latex, pdf), sections report (sections) tables report data frames: main_species main_countries, species mean temperature catch FishBase matches (mtc_species), results analyses (analyses), CMSY++ cmsy_reference_points (r, k, MSY, Fmsy, Bmsy, B/Bmsy F/Fmsy 95% confidence limits), cmsy_priors (resilience, r, k B/k priors, sources links FishBase SeaLifeBase, FishBase data, CMSY++ code FAO data) full CMSY++ result cmsy. Assign , e.g. report <- fao_report(...), look tables (View(report$cmsy_priors)). cmsy = TRUE, CMSY++ results (runs, charts tables) kept folder cmsy/ next report, cmsy_result.rds write report without running CMSY++ (cmsy = readRDS("cmsy/<area>/cmsy_result.rds")).

title: Assessment Report of an FAO Fishing Area — fao_report
text: Every analysis section can switched (total, species, ..., cmsy). settings function section given section name prefix, e.g. species_h_value = 0.2 h_value = 0.2 fishing_area_species() cmsy_top = 5 top = 5 cmsy_area(). abstract, methods, conclusions references follow sections switched . Chinese reports follow format project reports: A4 pages; body text FangSong Times New Roman, size 12 (xiao si), 1.5 line spacing first-line indent two characters; title bold FangSong, size 18; "abstract" SimHei, size 15; section headings SimHei subsection headings KaiTi, size 14; captions SimHei, size 12, numbered report (figure 1-1, table 1-1), figures tables; three-line tables text FangSong, size 10.5; numbered references superscript square brackets, order citation (GB/T 7714). English reports structure, one font (Arial default), author-date citations APA style style FAO publications. Scientific names species genera italics. text templates inst/extdata/report_text.csv references inst/extdata/report_references.csv package source: edit change wording.

title: Assessment Report of an FAO Fishing Area — fao_report
code: if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{ fao_report(34)                                  # Chinese or English, from fao_settings() fao_report("Atlantic, Eastern Central", lang = "zh", author = "Hongyu Lin") fao_report(34, lang = "en", font = "Times New Roman", citation = "fao")  # The other analyses of the package, with their settings fao_report(34, lang = "zh", shocks = TRUE, collapse = TRUE, synchrony = TRUE, pelagic = TRUE,            mtc = TRUE, distant = TRUE, collapse_method = "worm2006", distant_countries = 5)  # Only some sections, with settings of their functions fao_report(34, lang = "zh", quality = FALSE, diversity = FALSE,            species_h_value = 0.2, status_smooth = TRUE)  # With a CMSY++ assessment of the 10 main species (a few minutes) report <- fao_report(34, lang = "zh", cmsy = TRUE) report                                         # the tables it returns View(report$cmsy_reference_points)             # r, k, MSY, B/Bmsy, ... with 95% limits View(report$cmsy_priors)                       # priors, sources and links fao_report(34, lang = "zh", top_n = 15, cmsy = TRUE, cmsy_top = 5)  # Reuse CMSY++ results to rewrite the report fao_report(34, lang = "zh", cmsy = readRDS(file.path("reports", "cmsy", "Atlantic__Eastern_Central",                                                       "cmsy_result.rds"))) } # }

"grainger_garcia" pelagic demersal fishes, Grainger Garcia (1996) oceans: pelagic = herrings, sardines, anchovies, tunas billfishes, miscellaneous pelagic fishes; demersal = flounders, cods hakes, miscellaneous coastal demersal fishes, sharks rays, unidentified marine fishes. Invertebrates left . groups can given pelagic demersal. published studies classed species (habitat diet), ISSCAAP groups, FAO revised ISSCAAP fish groups 33, 34 37 2001, values roughly comparable function. groups mix pelagic demersal species: example, miscellaneous coastal fishes (group 33) include sandeels mullets, studies count pelagic.

(2000) found P/D 1 oligotrophic seas (e.g. Levantine Ionian seas), around 1 3.5 mesotrophic seas (e.g. North Sea, Adriatic) around 6 20 eutrophic seas (e.g. Black Sea, Sea Azov, Baltic), positive relation ln(P/D) chlorophyll; described classes subjective overlapping. ratio also changes reasons nutrients: Fishing markets: demersal fishes usually higher demand, overfishing alone raises P/D (de Leiva Moreno et al. 2000; Caddy et al. 1998); rules gears purse seines change (Hondorp et al. 2010). Oxygen: hypoxia demersal benthic stocks decline pelagic fishes less affected, P/D can rise hypoxia rather nutrients alone (de Leiva Moreno et al. 2000; Hondorp et al. 2010). Natural variability: small pelagic stocks fluctuate strongly climate, species can drive ratio (Grainger Garcia 1996; Hondorp et al. 2010). Reporting: catch identified species ("Marine fishes identified", shown unidentified_pct) probably mostly demersal (Grainger Garcia 1996), share changes time.
